title: How Big Is the GTA 6 Map? About Twice GTA 5 🗺️ #Shorts
description:
How big is GTA 6's map? Rockstar North's Aaron Garbut told Game Informer that Leonida is roughly twice the size of GTA 5's map and the studio's biggest world "by some degree". Edge reported its landmass is nearly GTA 4, GTA 5 and Red Dead Redemption 2 combined. Rockstar never gave an exact square-mile figure; Insider Gaming estimates about 39 sq mi of land and ~60 with water.

Sources: Game Informer (via KitGuru), Edge magazine (via Forbes), Insider Gaming estimate.
Images: Rockstar Games (official trailers / An Extended Look).
Fan channel, not affiliated with Rockstar Games.
